name: TodoMVC approved spec to executable tests

acceptance_criteria: When there are no todos, the main todo list area and footer are hidden.
The new-todo input is focused on page load.
Pressing Enter in the new-todo input creates a todo only after trimming whitespace and rejecting empty input.
The new-todo input is cleared after a todo is created.
The mark-all checkbox toggles all todos and reflects whether all individual todos are completed.
Each todo can be marked complete or active individually via interaction with the todo item.
Double-clicking a todo label enters editing mode and focuses the edit input.
Edits are saved on blur and on pressing Enter after trimming whitespace; empty edited titles destroy the todo.
Escape while editing discards changes and exits editing mode.
Hovering a todo shows its remove button.
The active counter is pluralized correctly: 0 items, 1 item, 2 items.
The clear-completed button is visible only when completed todos exist and removes completed todos when clicked.
Todos persist to localStorage using item fields compatible with id, title, and completed.
Routes are supported for all (#/), active (#/active), and completed (#/completed) filters.
Changing routes filters the todo list and updates the selected filter link.
If a todo changes state while a route filter is applied, the visible list updates immediately.
The active route/filter persists across reloads.
The implementation is a React app mounted from index.html into #root with React source under src/.
edge_cases: Whitespace-only edited title destroys the todo.
Malformed localStorage data is handled without persisting editing state.
Visible list updates immediately under active route filters.
The app remains browser-runnable through index.html and the project-defined React toolchain.
non_goals: Do not add dependencies unrelated to the approved React implementation.
risks: Browser support policy is not defined.
React toolchain setup must remain minimal and justified by the approved project context.
scope: Generate executable Playwright tests under tests/ for a React TodoMVC app with an index.html entry and React source under src/.
test_plan: Use Playwright end-to-end tests for TodoMVC UI workflows.
Navigate through the project-configured baseURL or `/` instead of hardcoded filesystem paths.
Interact only with public TodoMVC controls and standard TodoMVC selectors.
Cover localStorage persistence and route filtering.
Install or add required test tooling dependencies when needed for Playwright discovery or execution, and report dependency_changes.
Run generated Playwright tests to prove the suite is red before Builder implementation, and report failures without fixing production code.
